messages:
noah: Hi folks 1 1 I'm prepping my first PR touching runtime and a couple of config files. Quick checklist Qs: branch naming, commit messages, and any must-follow pre-merge steps?

tara: Welcome! Branching: feature/<name>/short-desc for new stuff, bug/<short-desc> for fixes, and hotfix/<ticket> for release fixes.

josh: For commits: keep them atomic while developing, but squash WIP before merge. Final commit must follow Conventional Commits: type(scope): short summary.

noah: Any short example I can copy paste for the commit body?

tara: Sure:

```
fix(runtime): avoid stale kv cache when request aborted

The runtime previously left stale kv state when an early abort happened. This caused prefix hits across requests.
Test: unit + smoke integration.
Resolves: #789
```

josh: PR description should include: What, Why, How to test, Risk, Rollout. Use the PR template; it puts a checklist in for you.

ci-bot: redwood-ci: started checks for PR #482 1 lint, unit, typecheck. https://ci.redwood.ai/build/482

noah: Pre-commit hooks? run locally?

tara: yes, run `pre-commit run --all-files` then `pytest -q`. Formatting: `black .` and `ruff format`. Saves CI time.

josh: CODEOWNERS at .github/CODEOWNERS will auto-request reviewers. If your change touches eng-runtime expect @eng-runtime reviewers.

noah: If CI fails after merging something small, do we revert or patch forward?

tara: Prefer patch forward unless production SLA is impacted. For regressions visible to customers open a revert PR and ping eng-sre oncall.

devex-bot: Pro tip: interactive rebase before force-push `git rebase -i origin/main` then `git push --force-with-lease`. See CONTRIBUTING.md and STYLE.md in repo root.

noah: Anything else specific to runtime PRs?

josh: Add a tiny perf check if touching hot path, and include config defaults in docs if you change them. Keep PRs < ~400 LOC when possible; split large refactors.

noah: Thanks! I'll run the hooks and ping @tara when the PR is ready for review. :raised_hands:
